note: Max rank of each spell, read off the page in a browser and hashed there and on disk. A reference: nothing imports it.

top.text: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 342 to 381 Nature damage.

Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 517 to 545 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.
Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.
Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 480 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.
Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 292 Fire damage immediately and 320 Fire damage over 12 sec.
Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 to 54 Fire damage.

spells.name: Fire Nova
reasons: Called Fire Nova Totem in Classic

top.text: Instantly inflicts 232 to 259 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.
Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.
Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 495 to 524 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.
Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.
Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 73 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.
Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 495 to 552 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

spells.name: Lightning Mastery
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it

top.text: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 653 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Requires Melee Weapon
Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 30. Lasts 5 min.

The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 178 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 35 to 112 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Requires Melee Weapon
Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.

Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 169 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Requires Melee Weapon
Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.
Relocates your active totems to your location.
Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.
Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 60, if within 30 yards.
Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.
Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party or raid members within 30 yards by 60.

Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit causes 17 to 55 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 5 min.
Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.
Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to your home location. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.
Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.

Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 333 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Requires Melee Weapon

Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 246 extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.

Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and Shaman sight.
Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 64. Lasts 5 min.
Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Stormstrike
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it

top.text: Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

spells.name: Rage of the Farseer
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it

top.text: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.
Heals a friendly target for 1508 to 1722.
Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
Cures 1 poison effects on the target.
Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 5 min.
Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 11 every 2 seconds.
Heals a friendly target for 775 to 865.
Cures 1 disease on the target.
Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Mana Tide Totem
reasons: A talent in Classic and in Forever
Ranks 1 to 3 trained earlier than in Classic

top.text: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.
Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

Heals the friendly target for 474 to 539, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.

spells.name: Riptide
reasons: Not in Classic; its first rank comes from a Forever talent
Season of Discovery had a spell by this name

top.text: Heals a friendly target for 805 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

spells.name: Water Shield
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it

top.text:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

spells.name: Nature's Swiftness
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it

top.text: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.
